answer: Every identity pays rent. The protocol burns 50,000 POA from its wallet in every epoch it is registered, starting with the epoch it joins, and leaving refunds nothing. The floor payout is 45,000 POA, so an identity that only collects the floor loses 5,000 POA each epoch, and 1,000 of them lose 5 million per epoch while burning 50 million in rent. Joining only for paying epochs cannot help, since each epoch costs the same. Splitting coins cannot help either, since rent is per identity. An inlet of new keys, an umber pile of dormant ones or a walnut of recycled wallets all pay it.
